sentences.en: He took the reality of the situation lightly and failed.
sentences.zh: 他轻视了情况的真实性，结果失败了。

sentences.en: So lightly dο the multitude take the search for truth.
sentences.zh: 人们如此轻易地对待寻找真理这件事。

sentences.en: The girls were dancing lightly like so many butterflies.
sentences.zh: 女孩们像蝴蝶一样轻盈地跳舞。

senses.zh: 轻轻地；轻松地；容易地；不费力地
